items.title: Autonomous replenishment with Databricks MMF, Genie, and Amazon Quick
items.summary: Demand forecasting works at catalog scale, but value still leaks in the last mile, where a forecast must become a placed order. This post describes a pattern that closes that gap: Databricks Many Model Forecasting and a Genie Agent surface the forecast, and Amazon Quick reconciles it against an external supplier feed, placing routine orders automatically and escalating only the exceptions. The pattern applies well beyond supply chain.
items.creator: Venkatavaradhan Viswanathan
